messages.content_text:
Not every day is a trading day 

AVOID or COME BACK LATER IF: 

Market direction is unclear
,
Feeling stressed out from other life situations
,
Not available for designated trading hours
,
ie: dont trade off your phone or in a weird environment (you wouldnt take a sales call at a fuckin concert so dont trade if you arent in the right environment)

Strategy: 

Bias: MMXM + basic market structure

Entries 

Manipulation into HTF pd array with ideally the pd array being in discount or OTE
,


Scale into LTF (using TFA)
,


Draw out fib on LTF leg
,


Wait for retrace into LTF RB
,


Entry when we see a manipulation of a prev high/low into RB start or CE  (side note: SMT adds more confluence)
,

MAX TRADES: 2 

Lockout after 
 
first trade wins
,
second trade wins
,
both are losses
,

Risk management 
Divide drawdown by 7 = how much $ per trade 
For every trade won: re-divide drawdown by 7 


Nothing changes if nothing changes (edited)
